contract_plain_english: For the homogeneous one-dimensional constant-coefficient real system q_t + A q_x = 0, assume A has real eigenvalues and a corresponding basis of m eigenvectors. The source states that every vector has a unique expansion in this basis and that this yields a decomposition into waves, each propagating at the signed speed equal to its corresponding eigenvalue. The acoustic example has speeds −c and +c, representing leftward and rightward waves. The general decomposition is explained further by a reference to Chapter 3; the attached passage does not specify a solution regularity class or a general component formula. [Printed p. 1, (1.1); printed p. 2, acoustic scalar equations and directional interpretation; printed p. 3, opening paragraph.]
